articles.title: Disciplined AI agents are the disruptor needed to break the exchange churn model
articles.snippet: Programmable incentives that allow independent trading agents to earn only when portfolios rise will create a fairer market for retail customers, explains Naja.

articles.title: Polymarket weighs KYC requirements amid global crackdown on prediction markets
articles.snippet: The predictions market operator reportedly explored mandatory user verification requirements, breaking from its policies of allowing traders to access its services using pseudonyms.
